meta.title: Pullwise — which pack to open in Pokémon TCG Pocket
meta.description: Build your deck, mark the cards you are missing, and find out which pack to open and how many you will need.

decks.missing: {count, plural, one {# card missing} other {# cards missing}}
decks.emptyBody: Pullwise never asks you to log your whole collection. Build a deck, mark the few cards you are missing, and it tells you which pack to open to finish it.
decks.emptyAction: Paste a list you already have

ranking.nothingMissing: You are not missing anything for this deck.
ranking.strategy: Always opening the best pack for whatever is missing at the time.
ranking.censored: One card is so rare the calculation was cut short: treat this as a floor.

advisor.title: Which pack to open
advisor.emptyBody: Build a deck and mark the cards you are missing. With that, Pullwise can tell you which pack is worth opening and how many you will need.

browser.title: Cards
browser.marked: You marked {known, number} of {total, number}. The rest stays unopined, and that is fine.
browser.unmarked: Browse the catalogue. You do not need to mark anything: it fills in as you build decks.
